subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the landing path for this issue, or split the ordinary Feishu `send` replyTo gap into a narrower replacement PR?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-backed, but an overlapping proof-sufficient PR already exists and is currently conflicting with routing blockers, so automation should not open a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair The Open Feishu Anchor PR
options.body: Rebase and fix the existing PR so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while carrying the reply-anchor work through message-tool, media, card, and topic paths.

options.title: Open A Smaller Replacement
options.body: If the existing branch is too broad to repair safely, open a credited narrower PR for ordinary `send` explicit `replyTo` forwarding and leave topic-root work to the canonical topic issue.

options.title: Hold For Live Feishu Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until a Feishu-capable maintainer captures current-main live proof and chooses the exact reply-anchor boundary.

recommendation.title: Repair The Open Feishu Anchor PR
recommendation.body: Rebase and fix the existing PR so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while carrying the reply-anchor work through message-tool, media, card, and topic paths.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently owned merged Feishu action/media/card send repairs and is the strongest history-backed owner for choosing whether to repair or split the current Feishu plugin path.
